features.text: PDAC APPROVED L1932: Pediatric carbon fiber AFO for foot drop and mild spasticity management.
ENERGY-RETURNING FRAME: Stores and releases energy to improve walking efficiency and reduce fatigue.
LIGHTWEIGHT, LOW-PROFILE CONSTRUCTION: Designed for discreet wear under clothing to encourage active play.
ADJUSTABLE STRAPS: Customizable fit accommodates growth and activity changes.
CHILD-FRIENDLY SUPPORT: Provides gentle stabilization for gait correction and neuromuscular balance.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
